notes.title: UNDETECTED IS OUT NOW! 20% LAUNCH DISCOUNT!
notes.content:
It's time to get your sneak on and enjoy some classic, top-down stealth action because Undetected has officially launched and is available to download right now (with 20% discount for a limited time)!

You take the role of Tenoch Kaan, an expert in non-lethal infiltration and agent for the revolutionary group, Los Desplazados. Fitted with a cybernetic eye enhancement, Kaan is able to use an augmented top-down view to survey his surroundings. He also has a selection of non-lethal bullet types and explosives at his disposal to stay one step ahead of the enemy.
 
Stay in the shadows and use stealth to sneak past guards and avoid detection. 

And, of course, Undetected comes complete with crunchy retro textures and models for that authentic, old-school aesthetic! 

[previewyoutube=QSE6UKe5Yxk;full][/previewyoutube]


 If you play Undetected and would like to leave some feedback, go ahead and drop it here: Undetected Feedback
 If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please report them in this thread: [url=]Undetected Bug Reports
 Undetected will also launch later this year on PlayStation, Switch, and Xbox
 If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a user review. Every review really helps!

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy Undetected!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1715350/UNDETECTED/

Below is a selection of just some of the sneaky goodness Antonio's posted so far, but be sure to check out the full Twitter thread for other art and assets, and also extra insight into the game's themes, characters, inspirations, and development process. And there's more to come as Antonio will be adding to the thread all the way to launch day!

notes.title: Demo V1.1 Patch now available!
notes.content:
Demo v1.1 Patch Now Available!

Thanks to everyone who has tried UNDETECTED and sent feedback! We are working on making it the best it can be!

New features for the demo:


 New visibility indicator - Kaan's tattoos glow when he is invisible
 New difficulty mode "Classic" - for people who want the classic stealth action experience
 Fixed issues with long grass and lights

notes.title: PLAY THE DEMO! WATCH THE NEW TRAILER!
notes.content:
UNDETECTED is participating in Next Fest, which means we have a demo for you to try – it's available to download and play now from the store page! 

Featuring the game's opening jungle section, the demo offers a chance to sample the stealth mechanics and try some of the non-lethal bullets and explosives you can use to distract and/or immobilize enemies.

We're also delighted to share the news that Digerati is now the game's publisher, and in addition to the PC version, UNDETECTED will also be released on PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox One and Xbox Series. As if all that isn't enough excitement, there's also a brand new trailer for you to enjoy!  

[previewyoutube=UztFgilMN7w;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you have fun with the demo. Happy sneaking!

Matt | Digerati
